## 2026-10-06 — Reconcile identity, recorded perception and chosen action

The [identity contract](identity-and-references.md) now describes implemented authenticated world grants, control generations and observer-scoped model handles instead of the superseded single-principal, raw-ID and old-save conversion design. The [knowledge contract](knowledge.md) acknowledges delivered owner-private character notes without implying a private messaging channel or complete hosted security qualification. Existing role-derived local identity repair is explicitly included in [DF04](maintainers/production-data.md#df04--retire-residual-compatibility-paths), preserving valid current bindings, deliberate world creation and account authority outside gameplay rewind. The protected development policy is unchanged.

[World Events](perceived-world-events.md) now points to the actual scoped read route and wire contract, with supported type-filter behavior and the recorded observer-safe target-name repair. The [encounter scaling plan](encounter-scaling.md) separates delivered private noticing, change-fed intake and incremental sensory preparation from remaining episode, durability and full-stack capacity qualification; it no longer schedules their initial implementation again. [Invention dependency graphs](invention-graph.md) use the shared family/material dependency extractor rather than a gathering-only description. These corrections prevent competing data paths and obsolete implementation work without declaring the wider projects complete.

[Agency](agent-agency.md) distinguishes implemented finite pursuit from remaining targets and removes residual automatic-feeding implications: people choose their actions, while installed bodily consequences and admitted native work continue independently of providers. [Targeted actions](targeted-actions.md) distinguish the current cooperative human-versus-human strike denial from still-unimplemented PvP consent and consequential-death policy. No gameplay behavior, permissions or numerical limits changed in this reconciliation, and no unmet acceptance gate is marked complete. Historical runtime evidence retains its exact scope; no new game, database, browser or provider qualification is claimed.
